records.name: Flamingo Las Vegas
records.current_summary: Built with mob financing; Bugsy Siegel skimmed construction funds, leading to his 1947 murder; Lansky held hidden interests per FBI and Kefauver Committee findings.

records.name: Desert Inn
records.current_summary: Moe Dalitz, a Cleveland mob figure, was the public face; Kefauver Committee and Nevada Gaming Control Board documented hidden mob profit participation.

records.name: Sands Hotel and Casino
records.current_summary: Kefauver Committee and FBI records confirm Chicago Outfit and Lansky hidden interests; skim operations documented in 1970s federal prosecutions.

records.name: Dunes Hotel & Casino
records.current_summary: Reporting and Nevada licensing files tied hidden interests in the early years to organised crime.

records.name: Riviera Casino
records.current_summary: Credible reporting links early investors to Midwest mob figures, but no convictions tied directly to casino operations.

records.name: Tropicana Las Vegas
records.current_summary: Hidden mob interests at opening (Frank Costello); in the 1970s Kansas City mob figures skimmed the casino in the FBI investigation known as Operation Strawman.

records.name: Stardust Resort & Casino
records.current_summary: Skimmed for years: the 1970s-80s FBI case Operation Strawman and the Argent Corporation scandal ended in convictions; the story behind the film Casino.

records.name: Caesars Palace
records.current_summary: Construction financed by Teamsters pension fund under mob influence per federal convictions; no direct mob ownership after opening.

records.name: Circus Circus Las Vegas
records.current_summary: Jay Sarno's financing connections raised regulatory scrutiny; no proven mob ownership after licensing.

records.name: Bellagio
records.current_summary: Developed by Steve Wynn's Mirage Resorts with no mob ties; fully corporate financing.
